selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=VOUT) and exposed pad net (GND).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.01–3 Ω (p.13)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 10 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (150 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (26 V rec / 26 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
